buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-border text-text_primary hover:bg-surface_elevated font-medium px-4 py-2 rounded-sm transition-transform active:scale-[0.98]

agent_node.running: border border-state-running/50 bg-surface shadow-[inset_0_0_12px_rgba(255,176,0,0.1)] text-text_primary relative overflow-hidden before:absolute before:inset-0 before:bg-gradient-to-r before:from-transparent before:via-state-running/10 before:to-transparent before:-translate-x-full before:animate-[shimmer_2s_infinite]

icons_and_media.icon_style: weight='regular' for idle/secondary, weight='fill' for active/primary

images.description: Black and white geometric grid pattern. Use as a very subtle background mask (opacity-5) in the header or hero section to break the digital flatness.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure all text meets APCA guidelines. Use text_secondary (#8A8F98) only for non-critical information.
accessibility_and_testing.focus: All interactive elements MUST have focus states: focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-text_primary
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: MUST include data-testid on all interactive elements. E.g., data-testid='agent-node-coder', data-testid='download-zip-button', data-testid='intake-submit-button'

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the dark theme colors provided. Do not invent gradients or new colors.
Use Phosphor Icons for all UI iconography.
Implement the layout using a 'Control Room' grid strategy. Dashboards should be dense, maximizing viewport usage. Use flex-1 and h-full to avoid jagged bottom edges.
For the Agent Pipeline Visualizer, map the 7 agents (Intake, Architect, Planner, QA, Coder, Validator, Recovery) sequentially. Use the `agent_node` component classes based on their state.
The Log Terminal MUST use JetBrains Mono (or fallback to monospace) and feel like a real terminal.
Avoid Shadcn 'Card' wrapper if it introduces too much padding or shadow. Prefer raw divs with 'bg-surface border border-border rounded-sm p-4'.
Make the Project Explorer a tree view structure.
Ensure the layout is highly technical and mimics tools like Linear or LangSmith (1px solid borders, no soft shadows, strict monochrome with bright functional accents).
